svg.title: CI/CD: pipelines and quality gates — Week 14 · Session 1
svg.text: How a distributed team ships many small changes — fast, without breaking things
a machine checks it on every change.

g.text: CI, CD and CD: how far do I automate?
More automation → same pipeline; you choose how far to go
Passenger = your change · Checks = quality gates
A check beeps → you don't board (no merge)
Pass them all → ready to fly (releasable)
The pipeline enforces quality — on every push and every PR
Quality gates = automated Definition of Done
Any red gate → the build fails and the merge / deploy is blocked
All green → releasable artifact, ready for production
→ main always releasable = foundation of CD
How often do we reach production?
Small batches + automation → fast and stable
“The pipeline protects the team from the team”
